notes.subject: ערום
notes.rationale: 'crafty/shrewd' — same word as the serpent in Stat 3:1; here positive-cunning, rendered as prudent-lookout

notes.subject: em i giaman
notes.rationale: copula added: Hebrew is bare 'folly of fools [is] deceit', Tok Pisin needs predicate

translation: Hatkamap tok bilong man i save lukaut gut, em i save long rot bilong em; tasol ol nupela pasin bilong ol man olpela i no gat save, em i giaman.
